SELECT CASE WHEN overall_score BETWEEN 0 AND 59 THEN '0-59' WHEN overall_score BETWEEN 60 AND 69 THEN '60-69' WHEN overall_score BETWEEN 70 AND 79 THEN '70-79' WHEN overall_score BETWEEN 80 AND 89 THEN '80-89' WHEN overall_score BETWEEN 90 AND 100 THEN '90-100' END AS score_range, COUNT(*) AS count FROM t_evaluation WHERE overall_score BETWEEN 0 AND 100 GROUP BY score_range ORDER BY MIN(overall_score)

SELECT CAST(created_at AS DATE) AS interview_date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM t_interview_session WHERE created_at >= #{startTime} AND created_at < #{endTime} GROUP BY CAST(created_at AS DATE) ORDER BY interview_date

WITH score_counts AS ( SELECT session_id, COUNT(*) AS score_count FROM t_score_record GROUP BY session_id ) SELECT s.id AS session_id, s.user_id, s.job_id, s.candidate_name, s.status, s.started_at, s.finished_at, s.created_at, CASE WHEN s.status = 2 AND s.started_at IS NOT NULL AND s.finished_at IS NOT NULL AND s.finished_at < s.started_at + INTERVAL '2 minutes' THEN 'TOO_SHORT' ELSE 'MISSING_SCORE_RECORD' END AS reason FROM t_interview_session s LEFT JOIN score_counts sc ON sc.session_id = s.id WHERE ( s.status = 2 AND s.started_at IS NOT NULL AND s.finished_at IS NOT NULL AND s.finished_at < s.started_at + INTERVAL '2 minutes' ) OR ( s.status = 2 AND COALESCE(sc.score_count, 0) = 0 ) ORDER BY s.created_at DESC, s.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
